title.en: A Day When Everything Went Wrong

subtitle: 記錄一個接連出狀況的日子，以及你怎麼面對
task: Write a diary entry about a day when things kept going wrong. Describe what happened in order, how you dealt with it, and what you learned by the end of the day.
taskZh: 寫一篇日記，記錄一個接連出狀況的日子：依時間順序寫出發生了什麼、你怎麼處理，以及一天結束時學到了什麼。
focus: 用過去式與過去完成式交代事情先後
用時間轉折詞串起一連串事件
結尾有反思，不只是抱怨

en: Today started badly and only got worse. My alarm did not go off, so I woke up forty minutes late. By the time I reached the bus stop, the bus had already left. I ran all the way to school in the rain.
Things did not improve after I arrived. I realized that I had left my report on my desk at home, so I had to ask my teacher for one more day. Then, at lunch, I spilled soup all over my shirt.
Looking back, none of these problems was serious. My teacher was kind, and a friend lent me a jacket. Tonight I set two alarms and put my report in my bag, so tomorrow should be better.
zh: 今天一開始就很糟，而且越來越糟。鬧鐘沒有響，所以我晚了四十分鐘才起床。等我到公車站時，公車早就開走了。我在雨中一路跑到學校。
到學校之後情況也沒有好轉。我發現報告忘在家裡的書桌上，只好請老師再給我一天。接著午餐時，我又把湯灑得整件襯衫都是。
回頭看，這些問題其實都不嚴重。老師很體諒，朋友也借了我一件外套。今晚我設了兩個鬧鐘，也把報告放進書包，所以明天應該會好一點。
